integrity: The lower bound is proved directly by coordinate projections, and the upper bound uses an explicit clique with a perfect matching or a one-vertex odd-parity extension. Exhaustive finite computations are corroborative only.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is restricted to finite reduced commutative rings that are not fields.
The paired-domination number records only the smallest field-factor order and its parity, not the full product decomposition.
No paired-domination-polynomial formula or nonreduced-ring extension is claimed.
title: Paired domination of total graphs of finite reduced rings
